facts.P1_fx_receipts: Probably freely; Liberian and US dollars are both legal tender.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Not confirmed yet, though USD accounts are common.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register at the Liberia Business Registry and renew every 12 months.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN, issued when you register your business.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed: nil to LRD 70,000, up to 25%.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 13% GST on services; a full VAT starts January 2027.
facts.L5_data_protection: No data protection law yet; a bill was before the Legislature.

watch_out.text: Trading without a valid yearly registration risks fines.
GST becomes VAT on 1 January 2027; registration opened July 2026.
